# Method SetMachiningRange

#### SetMachiningRange(DocumentId, SmartBoolean)

Set machining range state.

##### Declaration

```
[OperationContract]
[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 11, 300, 160)]
void SetMachiningRange(DocumentId inDocumentId, SmartBoolean inMachiningRange)
```

##### Parameters

|  Type |  Name |  Description |  
| --- | --- | --- | 
   
|  DocumentId |  inDocumentId |  Identifier of the document to modify.  |  
 
|  SmartBoolean |  inMachiningRange |  Machining range  |  

##### Remarks

StartModification(string, bool) and EnsureIsDirty(ref DocumentId) must be called before calling this method.
